world.name: Last Lantern
world.premise: A rain-soaked crossroads tavern where travelers trade rumors before the old roads.

timeline.summary: The player entered the tavern and asked who remembers the old north road.
Mara Underbough warned the player not to say the Ashford name loudly.

characters.name: Mara Underbough
characters.state: Generated resumable tavernkeep talent with local rumor knowledge.
relationships: Knows local travelers and old road debts.

locations.name: Last Lantern Tavern
locations.state: Warm, crowded, and tense when the Ashford name is spoken.

open_threads.summary: Mara warned that the Ashford name should not be spoken loudly.
The old north road and its stones are tied to old debts.
